jobs.excerpt: Lead-level frontend and mobile ownership.  AI-first delivery.
jobs.description:
Lead-level frontend and mobile ownership. AI-first delivery. Architecture decisions.

We are looking for a highly senior engineer who can operate at Lead Engineer level across frontend and mobile applications.

This is not a role for someone who only executes tickets. We need someone who can make architecture decisions independently, design scalable frontend and mobile systems, and turn ambiguous product needs into production-ready applications.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean team. The default mode of execution is AI-first. Engineers use AI agents and tools such as Cursor, Claude, and similar platforms to accelerate research, planning, implementation, testing, and refinement, but ownership stays fully with the engineer. The person in this role must be able to use AI to move fast while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, performance, usability, maintainability, and overall product quality.

The work

  • Design and own frontend and mobile application architecture across React, React Native, and

  • Make architecture decisions independently, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability

  • Build production-grade applications using TypeScript across web and mobile environments

  • Work with GraphQL APIs and define clean integration patterns across frontend, mobile, and API layers

  • Define scalable engineering patterns across React, React Native, , TypeScript, and GraphQL

  • Own application quality standards across architecture, code structure, testing, responsiveness, and developer experience

  • Define technical direction, not just implementation details

  • Set and enforce quality standards across both AI-generated and manually written code

  • Use AI-first and agentic development workflows with tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate delivery without compromising engineering standards

  • Translate ambiguous product needs into clear technical solutions

  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications across web and mobile

  • Collaborate directly with clients to ensure smooth communication and strong understanding of requirements

  • Contribute to system design, performance strategy, testing strategy, and engineering productivity

  • Apply a basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift when working with React Native integrations, debugging, or platform-specific requirements

This is a fast-paced environment with real production stakes. You will be expected to move quickly, think at systems level, and make strong technical decisions with minimal hand-holding. If you are comfortable owning frontend and mobile architecture, working across React, React Native, , TypeScript, GraphQL, and AI-first workflows, and raising the technical bar in a high-accountability environment, this role is for you.

Candidate requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React, React Native, , and TypeScript

  • Strong experience working with GraphQL APIs

  • Extensive AI/ML or agentic development experience using Cursor, Claude, or similar tools

  • Basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift

  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production web and mobile applications

  • Strong understanding of performance, responsiveness, maintainability, and overall software quality

  • Proven ability to make architecture decisions independently and own technical direction

  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and stakeholders

  • Full-time availability in a remote environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on development experience

  • Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Ability to pass a background check with good references

Details

  • Fully remote

  • Paid in USD

  • EST or PST aligned hours

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.
As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior React Native Engineer to help build, enhance, and refine a production mobile application using React Native, Expo, TypeScript, and modern React.

This is a highly hands-on frontend mobile engineering role focused on delivering polished, intuitive, and high-performance experiences across iOS and Android.

You'll join a small, fast-moving engineering team, collaborating directly with technical stakeholders and backend engineers to turn high-fidelity designs into production-ready mobile interfaces.

The ideal candidate has strong React Native expertise, exceptional attention to UI details, and the ability to quickly understand an existing codebase and deliver meaningful improvements from the first week.

This opportunity is particularly well-suited for engineers who enjoy ownership, rapid iteration, clean code, and building high-quality mobile experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain production mobile applications using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript.
  • Build new mobile screens and improve existing interfaces across iOS and Android.
  • Translate high-fidelity designs into pixel-accurate, responsive, and visually polished mobile experiences.
  • Develop interactive mobile features involving conversational interfaces, content presentation, and user interactions.
  • Ensure smooth animations, transitions, navigation, and native-feeling interactions.
  • Build reusable, maintainable React Native components using modern React patterns and hooks.
  • Integrate frontend features with backend APIs and collaborate with backend engineers on API contracts.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues, performance bottlenecks, and platform-specific inconsistencies.
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable, and documented code.
  • Deliver small, reviewable commits and participate in code reviews.
  • Occasionally contribute to React-based web interfaces.
  • Collaborate with engineering stakeholders to clarify requirements, prioritize work, and deliver improvements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in mobile UI quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • 3+ years of professional experience building and shipping production React Native applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React Native.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern React development.

  • Strong understanding of React hooks, component architecture, and modern React patterns.

  • Experience maintaining and enhancing existing production applications.
  • Strong understanding of testing and code quality practices.

Must Have:

  • 3+ years of production React Native development experience.
  • Strong TypeScript proficiency.
  • Strong experience with modern React, including hooks and component-based architecture.
  • Practical experience with Expo, or strong React Native experience with the ability to work effectively in an Expo codebase.
  • Experience delivering production mobile applications for iOS and Android.

  • Excellent attention to:
  • UI consistency and visual accuracy.
  • Typography and spacing.
  • Animations and transitions.
  • Responsive mobile layouts.
  • Native-feeling user interactions.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs or similar backend services.

  • Ability to deliver independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React Js / Next Js)
jobs.excerpt: Job Overview React and Next. js | 4 to 6 yearsThis role is responsible for building reliable, responsive user interfaces from approved designs and API contracts.
jobs.description:
Job Overview


React and Next.js | 4 to 6 years

This role is responsible for building reliable, responsive user interfaces from approved designs and API contracts. The developer should be able to deliver features independently, diagnose browser issues and contribute maintainable, well-tested code.

Must Have Skills

  • Strong experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript and hooks-based component development.
  • Good understanding of component lifecycle, effects, memoisation and techniques for preventing unnecessary re-renders.
  • Experience with Next.js, Vite or a comparable modern front-end build framework.
  • Experience with Zustand, Redux Toolkit or a similar state-management library, including correct and efficient use of selectors.
  • Strong HTML5, CSS3 and SCSS skills, including responsive layouts, semantic markup and scoped styling.
  • Working knowledge of accessibility fundamentals, including keyboard navigation, focus management and appropriate ARIA usage.
  • Experience using a design system such as IBM Carbon, Material UI or an equivalent component library.
  • Ability to implement interfaces accurately from Figma designs or other visual specifications.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and handling loading, error, empty and partial-data states.
  • Experience with polling, request cleanup and defensive handling of incomplete or unexpected API responses.
  • Working knowledge of environment configuration, package management and front-end build processes.
  • Experience writing unit and component tests with Vitest or Jest and React Testing Library.
  • Strong browser DevTools debugging skills and experience resolving cross-browser issues.
  • Working knowledge of Git branching, pull requests, code reviews and collaborative delivery workflows.
  • Ability to write clean, reusable and maintainable front-end code.
  • Good knowledge of secure client-side development, including environment variables and safe logging.

Good to Have Skills

  • Experience with animation libraries such as GSAP, Framer Motion or React Spring.
  • Experience with charting libraries such as Recharts, Chart.js, D3.js or High charts.
  • Hands-on experience with three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL or the HTML Canvas API.
  • Familiarity with performance profiling, bundle analysis, lazy loading and dynamic imports.
  • Experience with internationalization libraries such as react-i18next or next-intl.
  • Experience with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright
  • Familiarity with error boundaries, front-end monitoring and CI/CD pipelines.

• Familiarity with Azure DevOps

  • Experience working in an Agile team using Jira and Confluence.
Salary: $20 – $25 / hour
